import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main"}
M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main}"

def col_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    c = 0
    for ch in m.group(1):
        c = c * 26 + ord(ch) - 64
    return c - 1, int(m.group(2)) - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    names = [s.get("name") for s in wb.findall(f"{M}sheets/{M}sheet")]
    print("Sheet names:", names)

    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.findall(f"{M}si"):
            shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{M}t")))

    sheet_files = sorted([n for n in z.namelist() if re.match(r"xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml", n)],
                         key=lambda n: int(re.search(r"sheet(\d+)", n).group(1)))
    for i, path in enumerate(sheet_files):
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        rows = {}
        for row in root.iter(f"{M}row"):
            rnum = int(row.get("r"))
            cells = {}
            for c in row.findall(f"{M}c"):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find(f"{M}v")
                col, _ = col_idx(ref)
                val = None
                if t == "s" and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == "inlineStr":
                    isel = c.find(f"{M}is")
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in isel.iter(f"{M}t"))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = float(v.text) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(\.\d+)?([eE][+-]?\d+)?", v.text) else v.text
                cells[col] = val
            rows[rnum] = cells
        maxc = max(max(r.keys()) for r in rows.values()) if rows else 0
        total = 0.0
        print(f"\n=== Sheet {i+1}: {names[i] if i < len(names) else '?'} ===")
        for rnum in sorted(rows):
            line = []
            for c in range(maxc + 1):
                val = rows[rnum].get(c)
                line.append(val)
                if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
                    total += val
            print(rnum, line)
        print("TOTAL numeric sum in sheet:", total)

    c = 0

    return c - 1, int(m.group(2)) - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
